board: Arduino Nano 33 BLE Sense, Arduino mbed core

requirements.requirement: The sketch configures Serial1 (pins D0/D1) for communication at 9600 baud, 8N1, instead of using the USB Serial port.
On receiving the command ID?, the board replies with the student's own 9-digit university ID, keeping any leading zeros.
On receiving the command SUM?, the board replies with the sum of the digits of the student's ID.
On receiving the command HEX?, the board replies with the student's ID converted to upper-case hexadecimal, with no leading zeros.
On receiving any line that is not ID?, SUM?, or HEX?, the board replies with ERR.
The board accepts command lines terminated by either \n or \r\n, treating the \r as part of the line ending rather than part of the command.
The board ignores empty lines (lines containing only a line ending) and does not send any reply for them.
The board replies to each valid command within 100 ms of receiving the line ending.
The board keeps answering correctly to repeated commands for as long as it stays powered, not only the first time.
Every reply sent by the board ends with \r\n or \n.
The board prints nothing on Serial1 other than the defined replies, with no start-up message or debug output.
